answer: Make earning depend on a continuous work chain: a new identity starts at the edge of an orchard of verified jobs, and each completed task becomes a vertex linking to the next, so reputation grows only along an unbroken chain. A Sybil plume of fresh names has no chain at all, and buying one means paying for a full sequence of real, checked work per identity, with each link re-audited at random. Forging a hundred names therefore costs a hundred complete work histories, not a hundred registrations.
